name: Release Please (Open Source)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source release automation that generates changelogs, version-bump pull requests, Git tags and GitHub releases from Conventional Commits; no software-imposed release quota.
watch_out: Requires your own CI runner or GitHub Action and GitHub API credentials. GitHub Actions minutes, repository/API limits and package publishing fees are separate; release PRs still require your configured review and merge controls.
